Listen To The Evergreen “Nanna Neenu Gellalare” Audio Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Nee Nanna Gellalare, Featuring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Manjula.
Enjoy This Beautiful Evergreen Melody And Relive The Nostalgic Charm Of Classic Kannada Cinema.
If You Love Kannada Old Songs, Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Manjula Songs, Ilaiyaraaja Kannada Songs, Evergreen Kannada Melodies, Classic Kannada Movie Songs And Vintage Kannada Hits.
Directed by: Vijay
Produced by: S.A. Srinivas
Written by: M.D. Sundar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Manjula
Music Director: Ilaiyaraaja
